title: Pilot VMFA F/A-18 Qualified (LtCol to 2ndLt) PMOS, DC AVN
raw_text:
14.     MOS 7523, Pilot VMFA F/A-18 Qualified (LtCol to 2ndLt) PMOS, DC AVN

    a. Summary. VMFA Pilots operate an electronics equipped fighter-attack
aircraft to provide air defense and air support in all weather conditions,
day and night.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Security requirement:     secret security clearance eligibility.

        (2) Must meet the requirements of reference (ah) and the USN Manual
of the Medical Department.

        (3) Must complete the Centrifuge-Based Flight Environment Trainer
Course (A17KZA1) Ft Sam Houston, TX.

        (4) Must complete the Aircrew Refresher NASTP Training for Class 3
Aircraft Course (M17P2E3) Miramar, CA.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) All F/A-18 A/C/D qualified pilots receive the primary MOS 7523
after successfully completing either:

            (a) F/A-18 Pilot Category I Training Course (N25P4A4) NAS Oceana,
VA; or (M17P4A2) MCAS Miramar, CA for CAT I students.

            (b) CAT II students must complete the F/A-18 Pilot Category II
Training Course (M17P5H2) MCAS Miramar, CA.

       d.   Duties

        (1) Provides air defense during all weather conditions, day and
night, by coordinating with airborne and/or ground control intercept units to
intercept and destroy attacking enemy aircraft.

        (2) Provides air support by dive and glide bombing, rocket, and
strafing attacks.

            (3) Performs aerial reconnaissance, antisubmarine, and surface vessel
defense.

            (4) Executes offensive and defensive all weather fighter tactics.

            (5) Operates from carrier or land bases.

            (6) Commands or may assist in commanding an aviation unit.



                                           1-282                        Enclosure (1)
 1143                                                                  NAVMC 1200.1L



    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers 53-2011.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
